description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-132647. The previous active PRD belonged to ralph/self-iteration-20260519-122726 and all stories were passing, so it was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-133057/. No PR CI auto-fix context was present in progress.txt. Kickoff health: latest GitHub main CI run 26077819348 completed green while Codespaces prebuild 26077819155 was still in progress; local sampled checks for the known fresh-CI risks passed via `go test ./cmd/server -run 'TestBuildEmbeddingProvider|TestEmbeddedWebDist|TestSPA'` and `npm --prefix web test -- --run src/components/admin/__tests__/ComplianceReportsPage.test.tsx`. This PRD focuses on the next stale ObjectSet composer surface: filters can still be incomplete or use a UI-only operator shape that the backend WhereClause contract rejects.

userStories.name: Fail closed on invalid ObjectSet filter clauses
userStories.description: Make the ObjectSet composer validate filter where clauses against the backend-supported WhereClause contract before Execute or shared-link execution can send a malformed filter.
bdd_acceptance: Given the ObjectSet composer contains a filter ObjectSet whose `eq` clause has no field or value, When validation runs, Then Execute is disabled and the validation panel names the missing field and value.

Given a saved or shared filter ObjectSet contains the unsupported `neq` operator, When the composer renders it, Then Execute remains disabled with a specific unsupported-operator message and the builder no longer offers `neq` for new filter clauses.

Given a filter ObjectSet uses the backend-supported `isNull` operator with a field and no value, When validation runs, Then Execute remains enabled because `isNull` does not require a comparison value.

userStories.name: Expose logical Where groups in ObjectSet composer
userStories.description: Allow users to build backend-supported `and`, `or`, and `not` filter clauses in the composer instead of only accepting them from pasted or shared definitions.
bdd_acceptance: Given the user adds an `and` filter group with two child clauses, When the definition updates, Then the wire WhereClause contains `type: "and"` and a two-entry `value` array.
Given the user adds a `not` filter around an `eq` clause, When the ObjectSet executes, Then the backend receives the supported `not` shape rather than a UI-only pseudo-operator.
Given a saved definition with nested logical clauses is loaded, When it is rendered and saved again, Then the logical filter round-trips without losing children.

userStories.name: Cover text-search Where operators in ObjectSet composer
userStories.description: Expand the composer filter controls to cover the backend text-search Where operators users need for analyst-style ObjectSet queries.
bdd_acceptance: Given the user selects `contains`, `containsAllTerms`, or `containsAllTermsInOrder`, When they enter a field and text value, Then the wire WhereClause uses the selected backend-supported operator with a string value.
Given the user selects `startsWith`, When they enter a prefix, Then the definition validates and Execute is enabled.
Given a shared definition already uses one of the supported text-search operators, When loaded in the composer, Then the operator is shown as editable rather than rejected as unsupported.
